opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to deposit Bitcoin, exchange it for platform tokens, and commit at least $100 to lending, while inviting them to join through a referral link. The speaker describes unusually large projected returns, including “a two hundred and forty two percent return of interest” on a $100 loan over 299 days and “$9,057.58 in profit” from lending $5,010 for 179 days. The referral structure further rewards the speaker with 5% of a recruit’s initial investment and 3% of a further recruit’s loan. The denial that “this is not a scam” and the instruction to “invest responsibly” do not substantiate those projections. The available evidence does not establish whether any return was paid or whether funds were recovered.
